crossRefs.note: Then came there to him all his brothers, and all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before…
My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or…
Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse…

translations.web: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
translations.bsb: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is a wise man’s rebuke to a listening ear.
translations.kjv: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
translations.asv: As an ear-ring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, So is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
